description: Tap, type, clear, swipe, scroll, press a key, open a URL or wait: one UI step, then it waits for the screen to settle and reports changed/settled, snapshot quality, health, new elements. Target: an @eN ref from qa_snapshot, text, id, a native selector (WDA iOS), or x/y. For 3+ known steps, batch them in one qa_flow_run {flowYaml}. Details: docs/tools.md#qa_act.

for.description: wait: {settled:true} (default), or until an element (ref/text/id/selector) is visible; gone:true waits until it is not.

using.description: "accessibility id" = accessibilityIdentifier/testID; predicate string = NSPredicate; class chain = XCUITest.

ignoreOverlay.description: tap: tap even if an overlay/keyboard covers the target.

observe.description: diff (default after a snapshot): elements added/removed; full: capped list; none: verdicts only.

using.description: "accessibility id" = accessibilityIdentifier/testID; predicate string = NSPredicate; class chain = XCUITest.

timeoutMs.description: wait: max ms (default 8000, max 50000; larger values are clamped); others: settle-wait cap.

untilVisible.description: scroll: stop once visible (checked before the first swipe).

name: qa_act
title: Act on the screen
